messages:
maria: Heads-up — deploy-bot just pushed a release for analytics-service. PR was docs-only but the bot bumped from 1.4.0 -> 1.5.0. Can someone confirm whether we should revert to a patch bump?

aj: ah, saw that. deploy-bot heuristic treated any non-test/infra change as minor. That's too aggressive for docs-only.

release-bot: Deploy triggered by releasebot/auto-bump. Source: PR #4823 (docs: README + example). Proposed tag: v1.5.0. No code changes detected in src/ or pkg/.

david: If it's truly docs-only we should make it 1.4.1. Some customers pin to 1.4.x and we don't want them auto-moving to 1.5.0.

sophie: Agree. We also have dedicated customers who rely on minor bump semantics for feature flags. 1.5.0 implies new feature risk.

maria: I checked the PR — only README and examples under docs/. No API or behavior changes. We should revert and cut 1.4.1.

aj: Can we be more deterministic in the bot? Proposal: if changed paths match ^docs/ or README, treat as patch. Also respect PR labels: "chore/docs" => patch.

david: Strong +1 for label-driven exceptions. We still need an escape hatch: some docs changes (like deprecations) should maybe be minor. Maybe check for keywords in changelog: "deprecate", "breaking".

sophie: For immediate action — who can roll back the tag? release-bot created the release; we should delete v1.5.0 and re-run the bump job to create v1.4.1. I can do the deletion if we confirm.

maria: Please go ahead, Sophie. I'll open a tiny follow-up RFC to update bump heuristics. Suggested rules in RFC: - docs-only => patch - PR label overrides heuristics - path-based whitelist for docs/testing - keyword scan for deprecations/breaking to force minor/major

aj: FYI the current bot logic is here: 
```
- treats any non-test file change as candidate for minor bump
- looks for changelog entries to escalate
- no label checks yet
```

aj: I'll add a small change to the bot to honor labels first, then path checks. We can ship that as a deploybot config change this week.

release-bot: Confirmed: tag v1.5.0 deleted by @sophie. New release candidate: v1.4.1 (pending manual bump).

sophie: Done the deletion and staged v1.4.1. Cutting the patch now.

maria: Thanks. Action items: @aj raise PR to change heuristics; @maria write RFC (tiny); @sophie cut patch and monitor clients pinned to 1.4.x for anomalies.

david: One more ask — can release notes for bot bumps include the PR labels and changed path list? Makes triage faster.

aj: good call. I'll include PR labels + path-summary in the release body.

maria: Perfect. Closing this thread once we verify no regressions from the patch. :thumbsup:

sophie: Patch is live, monitoring logs now. No errors so far.

maria: ACK, thanks everyone.
